name: Party And Account Identification And Contact Information 1

PartyIdentification.name: Party Identification
PartyIdentification.definition: Identification of the party that legally owns the account.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Identification of the account owned by the party.

ContactInformation.name: Contact Information
ContactInformation.definition: Human entity, as distinguished from a corporate entity (which is sometimes referred to as an 'artificial person').
